title: WASiM Element Registry
description: The canonical catalog of buildable engine constructs that lens manifests project over (WASIM_LENS_MANIFEST_SPEC.md §4). An entry's `key` maps 1:1 to a frontend PALETTE key (model/edits.ts); a manifest palette item `ref`s that key. The General lens surfaces every entry.

advanced.description: Collapsed by default in the palette.

key.description: Stable id; a PALETTE key and a manifest `ref` target.

construct.description: Engine primitive or node value_rule this builds.

editor.description: structured = a real inspector editor exists; raw = JSON escape hatch.
